questions.question: The cost price of an article is ₹ 214. After allowing three successive discounts of 15%, 20% and 10% on its price, it is sold for ₹ 153. If is sold at the list price, then the profit (in ₹) will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP = Rs. 214

SP = Rs. 153

Three discount % are 15%, 20% and 10%

**Concept used:**

SP = MP - MP × Discount%

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

MP = 153 × 100/85 × 100/80 × 100/90

⇒ MP = 153 × 1000/612

⇒ MP = 250

Profit = 250 - 214 = Rs. 36

**∴ Required profit will be Rs. 36**

questions.question: Amit borrows a sum of ₹ 8,000 at 10% p.a. compound interest for 4 years. He repays ₹ 2,800 at the end of the first year and ₹ 2,600 at the end of the second year. To clear the loan, how much should he pay after 4 years, interest being compounded yearly?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount borrowed = Rs. 8000

**Concept Used:**

Amount = P (1 + R/100)T

P = Principal

R = Rate of interest

T= time

**Calculation:**

Amount left after 1st year = 8000 + (10% of 8000) – 2800

⇒ 8800 - 2800

⇒ 6000

Amount left after 2nd year = 6000 + (10% of 6000) – 2600

⇒ 6600 - 2600

⇒ 4000

Amount to be paid at the end of 4th year = 4000(1 + 1/10)²

⇒ 4000 × 121/100

⇒ 4840

**∴ At the end of the 4th year he pay Rs. 4840 to clear all his dues.**

questions.question: The average of the 4-digit numbers 1244, 2345, 33x3 and 4x38 is 2925. What is the average of (5x + 3) and (9x - 5)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 4-digit numbers 1244, 2345, 33x3, and 4x38 is 2925

**Concept used:**

Average = Total sum of all observations/ Number of observations

If xyz is a three digit number then it is in the form of 100x + 10y + z

**Calculation:**

Total value of all observations = 2925 × 4 = 11700 

According to the question,

1244 + 2345 + 33x3 + 4x38 = 11700

⇒ 33x3 + 4x38 = 11700 - 1244 - 2345

⇒ 33x3 + 4x38 = 8111

⇒ 3300 + 10x + 3 + 4000 + 100x + 38 = 8111

⇒ 110x = 8111 - 7341

⇒ 110x = 770

⇒ x = 7

Now,

Average of (5x + 3) and (9x - 5) = (35 + 3 + 63 - 5)/2

⇒ 96/2 = 48

**∴ The average will be 48**

questions.question: Let x be the smallest 5-digit number such that when it is divided by 5, 6, 7 and 21, it leaves the same remainder 4. What is the sum of the digits of x?
questions.solution:
**GIven:**

x be the smallest 5-digit number such that when it is divided by 5, 6, 7 and 21, it leaves the same remainder 4.

**Concept used:**

LCM method to find the number

**Calculation:**

LCM of 5, 6, 7 and 21 = 210

We know smallest five digit number is 10000

At first, we will divide 10000 by 210

By doing that we get,

47 as the quotient and 130 as the remainder,

So, now we need 210 - 130 = 80 more to get a number which is multiple of 210

So, smallest 5 digit number which is divided by 210 = 10000 + 80 = 10080

So, actual number is 10080 + 4 = 10084 [∵ 4 is the remainder in each case]

Sum of digits = 1 + 8 + 4 = 13

**∴ The sum of the digits of x is 13**

questions.question: Five men and 2 women can do a piece of work in 9 days, whereas 11 men and 5 women can do the same work in 4 days. To complete the same work in 6 days, the number of women required is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Five men and 2 women can do a piece of work in 9 days, whereas 11 men and 5 women can do the same work in 4 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the workers × time

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

(5M + 2W) × 9 = (11M + 5W) × 4

⇒ 45M + 18W = 44M + 20W

⇒ M = 2W

⇒ M/W = 2/1

So, efficiency of man and woman = 2 and 1

Now,

Total work,

45 × 2 + 18 = 108 units

Let x numbers of women be required to complete the task in 6 days,

So,

108/x = 6

⇒ x = 18

**∴ Required number of girls is 18**

questions.question: The speed of a boat downstream is 2.5 times the speed of the boat upstream. If the time taken by the boat for going 30 km downstream and the same distance upstream is 7 hours, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the boat downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed Ratio (Downstream : Upstream) = 2.5 : 1 = 5 : 2

Since distance is constant, Time Ratio (Downstream : Upstream) = 2 : 5

Total time units = 2 + 5 = 7 units

Given total time = 7 hours → 1 unit = 1 hour

Time taken downstream = 2 units = 2 hours

Speed downstream = Distance ÷ Time = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance (d) = 30 km

Total time (T) = 7 hours

Downstream Speed (D) = 2.5 × Upstream Speed (U)

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the speed of the boat upstream be U km/h.

⇒ Speed of the boat downstream (D) = 2.5U km/h.

⇒ Time taken downstream + Time taken upstream = 7

⇒ (30 ÷ D) + (30 ÷ U) = 7

⇒ (30 ÷ 2.5U) + (30 ÷ U) = 7

⇒ (12 ÷ U) + (30 ÷ U) = 7

⇒ 42 ÷ U = 7

⇒ U = 42 ÷ 7 = 6 km/h

⇒ Downstream speed (D) = 2.5 × 6
